en.title: Wildfires Break Out on Brač Island, Croatia; Nearly 700 Evacuated
en.summary: A large-scale wildfire occurred on Croatia's Brač Island, with flames spreading toward Milna town and nearby bays on the night of September 12. Nearly 700 residents and tourists were evacuated, and four firefighting aircraft were deployed. The fire remained uncontrolled on September 13, with burned area reaching 3,500 hectares.
